turns.question: What is my rising sign?
turns.text: Your rising sign is Mesha (Aries). It is the sign that was rising on the eastern horizon at your birth, and it shapes how you come across and how you start things. The planet that looks after it, Mars, sits in Kataka in your chart, in the part linked to home and inner peace, where it is weaker and works harder, so the drive of Mesha tends to show most when you are settling something close to home.

turns.question: Is there any chance for me to go abroad?
turns.text:
I'll read the personal reading guidance first, since this is a question about your own chart.

Now the reference notes for the travel and abroad chapter.

Going abroad is a question for your chart's 12th house (living far from home), 9th house (long journeys) and 3rd house (short trips), along with Rahu. Let me look at those placements.

Your chart has a few clear pointers:

**🌍 Rahu, the pull of far places**

Rahu sits in your 7th house (partnership), not in the 12th or 9th, so it doesn't point straight at living abroad. Traditionally, though, Rahu brings a strong appetite for new places and wider horizons, and in a partnership area it can show up as a partner from a different background or a life that looks beyond the familiar.

**✈️ The 12th house: Jupiter as its ruler**

Your 12th house (spending, rest, living away from home) is in Meena, ruled by Jupiter. Jupiter sits in your 8th house, in Vrischika, and it is a helpful planet to have there. Traditionally, Jupiter placed like this in the 8th connects the "far away" area with growth, research and study, which often shows up as settling somewhere new for learning or work.

**🧭 The 9th house: long journeys**

Your 9th house (long journeys, higher learning, the father) is in Dhanu, ruled by Jupiter as well. Its sign has a natural love of travel and learning. Because Jupiter is strong in your chart, the 9th house tends to bring its results through teachers, study and wider experience.

**🧳 Your running period**

You are in a Mercury life period until 2038, currently in the Venus sub-period until 19 September 2027. Mercury rules travel for study and work, trade and networks. After that, the Sun sub-period runs from 19 September 2027 to 26 July 2028, a stretch for recognition and authority. Traditionally, Mercury periods suit study, trade and skills that can be used anywhere, so this is a stretch where a course or work offer from overseas could fit well.

**Balance**

Your chart shows a real pull toward wider horizons, but the Venus sub-period currently running leans toward home, comfort and relationships, so a move abroad is more likely to come in a planned way. Good preparation helps: a skill or qualification that travels, savings for the first months, and a clear plan for family ties.

This is a tendency, not a promise: a visa, a job offer or a move depends on many things outside any chart. Would you like me to look at how the coming sub-periods change the picture, or your 12th and 9th houses in more detail?

turns.question: When is the next poya day and what is it about?
turns.text:
The App Context shows the December 2026 almanac for Colombo, and it lists one poya day that month: 24 December 2026. Today is 25 November, so that is the next one, about four weeks away.

Poya days fall on the full moon, and in Sri Lanka they are important Buddhist observance days. Many people go to the temple, keep the eight precepts, and take part in sil observances, and the day is a public holiday. The calculated full moon date is shown here, but the official Sri Lankan calendar can differ by a day, so check it closer to the time for religious observances.

turns.question: mage porondam hari da? rajju eka fail kiyala thiyenawa, baya wenna ona da?
turns.text:
Ov, mage porondam eka hondada kiyala balanna, pahasu wenna ona. Rajju eka fail weyi kiyanne eka wadagatama wadi wenna ona, ehema nisa mama ehi detail gannawa.

Rajju kiyanne oyage star dekai (Rohini, pada 2) saha mage star ekai (Hasta, pada 3) dekama Kantha (neck) rajju ekata wadena nisa. Meka parampara vishesha check ekak, ehi "dekama oba dekgema sukhaya" kiyana eka gena balana eka. Ehe nisa, score eka (11 out of 16) hondayi kiyala penuth, parampara anuwa meka ganan wenama ganna baya ekak.

Mekata ahanna tiyena deyak:
- Rajju fail weema, ehema nam bayawenna epa kiyala meka laa kara.
- Vedha check eka pass wela, ehe kiyanne ekata ekata wadinna ba kiyala ekak nathi wenawa.
- Nakath, Stree Deergha, Vashya, Linga, Vruksha wage factor kiidhakma agree wenne nehe. Ehenam, Rashi, Rashyadhipathi, Yoni, Gana, Mahendra wage factor wadi nisa, parampara anuwa softened wenawa.

Ahanna tiyenne: "fail" kiyanne parampara ekata wadi weyi, madi dhayakayakma nehe. Kasi thiyanawanam mage ekata wada, nisa poruwa karanna kalin, wedding nakath saha pirisi pudgalaya gena balanna. Oyata meka pilibanda thawa prashnayak thiyenawanam, match page eke porondam astrologer ekkak ekka kathaa karanna hondai.

**🌿 Looking after yourself**

Your chart draws the most attention to your home life, your health and your daily routines. None of this is a warning. It simply shows where looking after yourself early tends to pay off.

The reason is Mars, your strongest source of energy. It sits in your home area (the 4th house) and is weaker here, so it works harder. Mars is also linked to heat, inflammation and haste, so keep routine check-ups and do not ignore small signs.

**🩺 Health and daily habits**

The area of health and daily routine (the 6th house) is ruled by Mercury, which sits in your gains area (the 11th house). Mercury governs nerves, sleep and overthinking, so the stretch here is mostly mental strain.

Steady routines, enough rest and a check-up now and then tend to keep small problems from growing. If anything is worrying you, please see a doctor.

**🏠 Home, family and peace of mind**

Your home area is steadied by the Moon, which sits in the 3rd house. Peace at home matters more to you than most things. Keep a calm base at home and talk early with your mother and family when small disagreements come up.

**💰 Money and spending**

The 2nd house, which holds savings, is ruled by Venus, placed in your career area (the 10th house). Your 8th house, which covers shared money and sudden change, is ruled by Mars. Mars is also the planet that looks after your home, so money and home can pull on each other. Keep a clear savings plan and avoid large, sudden commitments without advice. A qualified financial adviser can help with real decisions.

**🤝 Partnership and marriage**

Rahu sits in your partnership area (the 7th house), and Mars looks at it. Tradition reads this as an area that asks for patience and open talk. Couples who talk early and avoid letting small things build up usually handle this well. A human astrologer can read both charts together.

**🧭 What helps**

Build steady routines, keep your home a peaceful base, save with a clear plan and talk openly with the people closest to you. This is a chart that rewards preparation.
